shots.text: The Spire was Solenne, made wrong. Six walls of stolen stone, and on every one, a Herald we had already buried.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A dark mirror of Solenne's six rings, upside down; on its walls the six Heralds as glassy grey Echo-Heralds.

shots.text: At the top gate, the Dawnblade turned and held it open for all of us. Her armour had gone grey. She held it until the last of us were through.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Seraphel in the top gate, armour drained of colour, sword blazing, holding the doors apart as the army runs past her. Her light goes out. (Seraphel leaves the party.)

shots.text: Tell Ysolde I saw one more dawn. That was all I wanted.
shots.speaker: seraphel
